note: Closes are BSE's own published figures, UNADJUSTED for corporate actions and carried through unchanged. An adjusted price is a number no exchange ever published, so this file does not contain one. Corporate actions come from corporate-actions.json, which reads BSE's own published history — they CANNOT be inferred from this file, because BSE carries PrvsClsgPric unadjusted and a bonus therefore passes a continuity check cleanly.
corporateActions: see public/data/corporate-actions.json — actions are not derivable from this file
